targets.rawSql:
SELECT
	date_bin('$__interval', timestamp) AS time,
	concat('[', coalesce(metadata.yard_tag, ''), '] ', thrs_data.technical_name) AS device,
	AVG(CAST(${field:join:__value AS DOUBLE)), AVG(CAST(}__value AS DOUBLE))
FROM public.marpower__thrs__${type} AS thrs_data
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT mqtt_topic, yard_tag FROM public.marpower__io_metadata WHERE mqtt_topic LIKE 'marpower/500000-thrs/%'
) AS metadata ON thrs_data.topic = metadata.mqtt_topic
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND ',' || '$device' || ',' LIKE '%,' || thrs_data.technical_name || ',%'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 2, 1 ASC

query.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT thrs_data.technical_name AS __value,
    concat(
        '[',
        coalesce(metadata.yard_tag, ''),
        '] ',
        thrs_data.technical_name
    ) AS __text
FROM public.marpower__io_metadata AS metadata 
RIGHT JOIN ( SELECT technical_name, topic FROM public.marpower__thrs__${type} GROUP BY  technical_name, topic) AS thrs_data ON thrs_data.topic = metadata.mqtt_topic
ORDER BY 1
